title: launch.service_spawn marks a test run's unit collectable, so a failed test unit is collected
intention: launch.service_spawn starts a unit whose env carries CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID with CollectMode=inactive-or-failed, so a test run's failed unit is collected; outside a run the default is kept.
why: Measured 2026-11-23 building e179281f6eff: once superclaude.py launches the ground loop through service_spawn, test_a_unit_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs reds 'loop killed gone=False state=failed'. The shell passed -p CollectMode=inactive-or-failed under a test id (ef541167c:cairn/devices/cc/superclaude:623-624); service_spawn cannot, and systemctl set-property refuses CollectMode after start. e179281f6eff waits on this ticket.
traces_to: Law 2 (a test run leaves no unit of its own, tickets d50d162c5428 and f04d5ef26a48) and RULE 1 (every OS action through the system device's launch tool).
how: Extend service_spawn's systemd-run argv with -p CollectMode=inactive-or-failed when env carries CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID; a red-first proof spawns a failing argv with and without the id.

clauses.claim: with CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID in the env passed to service_spawn, a unit whose process exits non-zero is gone (LoadState not-found) within 10s
with no CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID in that env, the same failing unit stays loaded with ActiveState failed

decisions.text: D1: in service_spawn's systemd branch, cmd gains ['-p','CollectMode=inactive-or-failed'] when (env or {}).get('CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID'); the reset-failed retry reuses cmd and carries it too. No other branch changes.

D2: the proof spawns [sys.executable,'-c','import sys; sys.exit(3)'] as cairn-proof-collect-<pid>-<n>, once with CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID and once with it stripped from env and os.environ's copy, polls systemctl --user show -p LoadState -p ActiveState for 10s, and in a finally stops and reset-fails both. Off systemd --user it prints UNMEASURED and exits 0.

measured.saw: systemctl --user set-property --runtime <unit>.service CollectMode=inactive-or-failed: 'Cannot set property CollectMode, or unknown property.'; the killed unit stayed loaded/failed
measured.how: systemd-run --user a sleep unit, set-property, kill -s KILL, show LoadState ActiveState

measured.saw: test_a_failed_unit_of_a_run_collects_itself: loop killed gone=False state='failed' with superclaude.py; green on ef541167c with the shell
measured.how: the proof run in wt-e179 and in a worktree at ef541167c
